response.overview: How does one determine what stays on as a memory, and what doesn't? Can one's actions change their destiny, or has it been already decided by something far beyond their control? A man has a final conversation with a stranger, revealing things about himself he never thought he would remember. The stranger asks him questions- some that he cannot answer, and some that he does not want to, not even to himself.  Moments blur into each other, and eventually, there is no telling where one ends, and the other begins.
response.title: Seven Minutes
